label: From Cartesian to vector form
subgoals: Rewrite y = mx + q as P - P0 = t*v
Pin P0 on the line with v parallel to it
Sweep t over R to trace every point

label: Parametric form
subgoals: Split v into k*i + h*j components
Equate i-parts and j-parts into x = x0+kt, y = y0+ht
Eliminate t to recover Cartesian form

label: Example
subgoals: Substitute x0=2, y0=1, k=3, h=3 into the system
Vary t to generate x=2+3t, y=1+3t point by point
